definition_of_done: At least one product-specific SOP is defined.
Each SOP has a trigger, preconditions, ordered steps, exceptions, outputs, controls, and metrics.
Every step identifies its persona owner and data reads or writes.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for domain_sop_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
